glosses: Gravitation, the universal force exercised by two bodies on each other by virtue of their masses.

examples.text: Some of the most beautiful and thus appealing physical theories, including quantum electrodynamics and quantum gravity, have been dogged for decades by infinities that erupt when theorists try to prod their calculations into new domains.
